name: kinetic-pan-canvas
title: Kinetic Pan Canvas
description: An infinite 2D canvas workspace supporting continuous pointer drag panning with coordinate grid readouts.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Infinite Viewport Drag Pan: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
